places.t: Shade beats paint, and Pacoima shows why
places.d: Los Angeles coated 700,000 square feet of asphalt in a reflective surface and measured the result. The numbers are real. They also answer a smaller question than the one I care about.

places.t: A shade tree is a soil problem first
places.d: Everyone agrees the Valley needs more trees. Almost nobody draws the hole they have to grow in. The arithmetic is simple, and it changes what a street can hold.
